entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of weeks ago. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered on December 22nd. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The color in person wasn't quite what I expected from the website photos. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I see. Well, according to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return, so you are well within the window. Since the box is unopened, I can approve that return for you right now.

That's great to hear. Now, shipping it back is a bit of a hassle. I was wondering, instead of a full return, could you offer me a partial credit and I'll just keep the helmet? Or maybe a discount code for my next purchase? I still want to buy some gear, just not in this color.

I understand the suggestion, but our system is only set up for full refunds on returned items. I am not able to offer a partial credit or a discount code for this type of return. My priority is ensuring you're happy with your gear's safety and fit, and the best way to do that is to help you return this helmet for a full refund so you can get one you love.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is perfectly fine then. Can you please process that for me?

Of course. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Sounds simple enough. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
